handoffs.message: persona service entry added to docker-compose.yml. Build: services/control-plane/persona/Dockerfile, PORT=8002, depends_on operator-bff+registry, healthcheck GET /health, host port 18002. Ready for review.

Review changes requested: `docker compose build persona` fails because compose uses `build.context: .` with `services/control-plane/persona/Dockerfile`, but that Dockerfile is written for a service-local context (`COPY requirements.txt .`, `COPY . .`, `CMD uvicorn main:app`). There is no repo-root `requirements.txt`, so the build stops at `COPY requirements.txt .`; under repo-root context `main.py` is also not at image root. Align the build context to `services/control-plane/persona` or rewrite the Dockerfile for repo-root paths, then resubmit for review.
Helper-claimed by Codex while Claude is dispatch-paused.

Persona service wiring is ready for review: compose entry present with PORT/env, depends_on on operator-bff and registry, healthcheck on /health, host port 18002, and build context corrected to services/control-plane/persona so the Dockerfile resolves its local requirements.txt. docker compose config passes.
Review approved: persona compose entry is correct — build context, PORT, depends_on, healthcheck, and host port 18002 all verified.
